# HELD-OUT evaluation corpus.
#
# PURPOSE: estimate whether the Phase 2 ASR prompt generalises, or whether its
# gains are confined to the terms it happens to contain.
#
# CONSTRUCTION RULE — do not violate it, or this file loses all value:
#
#   No term in the 16-term ASR prompt priority block may appear here, and no
#   phrase from dictation_corpus.txt may be reused. The terminology below was
#   chosen BEFORE looking at any result on this audio, and no term here may
#   ever be promoted into the prompt priority block on the basis of failing
#   here. Doing so converts this into training data.
#
# The prompt contains: linezolid, cefepime, piperacillin-tazobactam,
# trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Pneumocystis
# jirovecii, Enterococcus faecium, MSSA, MRSA, Clostridioides difficile,
# Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Escherichia coli,
# Klebsiella pneumoniae, Staphylococcus epidermidis, Candida auris.
# None of those appear below.
#
# All phrases are constructed and describe no real person.
# Categories mirror CLAUDE.md section 6, Phase 6.

# --- organisms not in the prompt ---
Cerebrospinal fluid cultures grew Listeria monocytogenes.
The abscess culture yielded Bacteroides fragilis and Prevotella species.
Serum cryptococcal antigen was positive and cultures grew Cryptococcus neoformans.
The wound culture grew Serratia marcescens resistant to ceftriaxone.
Sputum cultures were positive for Nocardia farcinica.
Galactomannan was elevated and cultures grew Aspergillus fumigatus.
Urine cultures grew Proteus mirabilis with an alkaline urine pH.
The blood culture isolate was Streptococcus mitis, penicillin susceptible.

# --- antimicrobials not in the prompt ---
Continue ertapenem one gram intravenously daily for four weeks.
Start micafungin one hundred milligrams intravenously daily.
Transition to oral posaconazole delayed release three hundred milligrams daily.
Add rifampin six hundred milligrams orally daily for biofilm penetration.
Begin doxycycline one hundred milligrams twice daily for fourteen days.
Continue metronidazole five hundred milligrams every eight hours.
Start dalbavancin fifteen hundred milligrams as a single dose.
Change to ceftaroline six hundred milligrams every eight hours.

# --- syndromes not in the prompt ---
Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a thoracic epidural abscess.
The patient underwent debridement for necrotizing fasciitis of the thigh.
Arthrocentesis confirmed septic arthritis of the left shoulder.
Chest imaging showed a loculated empyema requiring thoracostomy.

# --- negation ---
There is no evidence of metastatic infection on the survey.
The patient denies recent travel, sick contacts, or animal exposure.
Repeat imaging shows no residual collection.

# --- uncertainty and attribution ---
The elevated inflammatory markers may reflect an alternative source.
Culture-negative endocarditis remains on the differential but is unproven.
The family states that the fevers began before admission.

# --- numbers, units, laboratory values ---
The vancomycin trough was seventeen point two micrograms per milliliter.
The procalcitonin fell from four point eight to zero point six.
The platelet count declined from two hundred twelve thousand to sixty-four thousand.
Weight-based dosing was calculated at four point five milligrams per kilogram.

# --- laterality and anatomy ---
There is tenderness over the right sacroiliac joint.
The effusion is larger on the left than on the right.
The lesion is located in the left upper lobe anteriorly.

# --- ambiguous abbreviations (must NOT be expanded) ---
The note documents a prior CVA with residual weakness.
Her history includes RA treated with methotrexate.
The differential includes PE given the pleuritic pain.

# --- research terminology not in the prompt ---
We estimated the effective reproduction number using a renewal equation.
Isolates were assigned to transmission clusters using core genome typing.
The model adjusted for confounding using inverse probability weighting.
